faces.name: Special Move
faces.oracleText:
Choose two —
• Jump Kick — Destroy target artifact.
• Dash Attack — Put two +1/+1 counters on target attacking or blocking creature you control.
• Foot Toss — Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to any other target. Then sacrifice it.

faces.name: Species 8472
faces.oracleText:
Strange new worlds — When this creature enters, you gain life equal to the number of differently named lands you control.
This creature can't be blocked by artifact creatures.
This creature can't be the target of abilities from artifact sources your opponents control.

faces.name: Species Gorger
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, return a creature you control to its owner's hand.

faces.name: Species Specialist
faces.oracleText:
As this creature enters, choose a creature type.
Whenever a creature of the chosen type dies, you may draw a card.

faces.name: Specimen Collector
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token and a 0/3 blue Crab creature token.
When this creature dies, create a token that's a copy of target token you control.

faces.oracleText:

Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 9+.)
9+ | Flying

faces.name: Spectacle of Destruction
faces.oracleText:
Whenever one or more creatures die, put a wreck counter on this enchantment.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this enchantment has one or more wreck counters on it, remove a wreck counter from it and seek a nonland card.
